content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text treats the paternity issue as underdetermined because no text explicitly resolves it, which is the explicit-stating-verse inquiry that K-C retires when a pressing chain is weighed against a link.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"none","why":"The judge refused to resolve the chain collision on footing and instead called it underdetermined for lack of an explicit textual resolution of paternity, the retired stating-verse test."}
